outcome_evidence: In right_shoulder_cam, the drawer is open at frame 0. The robot approaches and aligns with its front/handle through frames 2–19, then visibly pushes the drawer inward in frames 20–21. This is unconfirmed completion of an ongoing closing attempt, not a visibly failed acquisition or an established local failure.
